machine: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 threads, 62.5 GiB), node v26.7.0
workload: 4096 × 3084 RGBA (12.6 Mpx), realistic (F.heightMap seed 2022) and busy (F.busyHeightMap seed 11, 27 px cells) art families, colour channels R = g, G = 3g mod 256, B = 255 − g; modes: (a) plywood auto-tonal (tonal, light-front, smoothing 1.65 mm × 2 passes, bonded, 8 sheets, 300 mm high); (b) plywood height (white-high, bonded, 8 sheets, 300 mm high; reported, not gating); (c) acrylic connected (tonal dark-front, smoothing 1.65 mm × 2, smooth corners, 5 sheets, 300 mm wide; KI-CONN-PERF)
rule: per preset, draftPx = the largest candidate in {720, 1024, 1280, 1536, 2000} whose warm-cache p95 (≥ 15 warm runs, E3 cache filled, sheets changed between runs) is ≤ 3.0 s on BOTH the realistic and the busy art family for the preset's workload (plywood: (a) auto-tonal; acrylic: (c) connected) on the reference machine; 720 when none qualifies (recorded as a known gap, G4.1). Desktop draftPxCap = the larger of the two preset values; mobile draftPxCap = 720 (mobile ≈ 4× slower, k provisional as in D.8). Deviation: 3.0 s p95 is twice the G4.4 desktop draft target (p95 ≤ 1.5 s, which needs the G4.1 worker pool); G4.4 re-measures against 1.5 s. fabMsPerMpx = the larger p50 of the (a) fabrication rows that finished ÷ fabrication raster Mpx (rounded up to 10 ms); mobile = 4 × desktop.

method.warm: E3 cache filled; construction.sheets alternates 8 ↔ 7 (5 ↔ 4 for acrylic) and the revision changes between runs, so construct reruns
method.overlayShare: Σ draft change-overlay polygon time (SBEngine.maskPolygons for e.added/e.removed) ÷ Σ construct-stage time over the warm runs

notes: Recorded 2026-10-08 with `node test/bench.js draft --record` (full method: 1 cold + 3 warm-ups + 15 warm runs per row, early stop per mode and family).
The raster of the COMPLEXITY_LIMIT rows (no snapshot) was filled in after the run from SBEngine.rasterPlan for the same draftPx; the bench now does this itself.

The (a) realistic 1024 row overlapped a run of the test suite on the same machine (one extra single-threaded process); the decision does not depend on it, because (a) busy at 1024 measures p95 3766.9 ms.

Background load: 1-minute load average 4.3-7.0 during the draft rows (desktop processes, ≈ 16 threads); it rose to 38 during the busy fabrication row (another workload on the machine), so that row and the late (c) busy row are loaded figures.

The busy family exceeds the desktop parts cap (258 parts/layer) in bonded mode at every measured draftPx and at the fabrication raster: those rows time the rejection (COMPLEXITY_LIMIT), which is what the user waits for. fabMsPerMpx uses the rows that finished (realistic).
